versions.content: Symbolic name of a software-component To mitigate this potential hazard it is possible to provide the AtomicSwComponentType along with an accompanying symbolic name that can be used for resolving the name clash. The symbolic name is provided by means of the attribute symbol of the meta-class Sym- bolProps owned by AtomicSwComponentType in the role symbolProps .
